title: Bog Factor - Emily at the Helm
description: This month Emily grabbed the reins, and finally earned her DJ license. She celebrates spring, April fool's day, and Easter.We have classic Folk Revival, Jazz, contemporary folky bits, and a brazillian tune about not wanting to get a haircut. A special mention to Peter Talisman who's website will take you on a quest as you listen to his album Lord of the Harvest.

title: Red Hot Nordic Bangers - February 2026
description: We're taking you on a tour of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Iceland. It was Up Helly Aa in Lerwick this week and it turns out they invented the festival because they just loved a book and started dressing as Vikings, so we've done a bit of the same. We had a lot of fun with this, and found hours and hours of rare grooves, freaky pop tunes, and some questionable hip hop. Keep it Nordic
tracklist: We Have A Map Of The Piano - múm

title: El Classico Bog Factor - December 2025
description: Its the last show of year 1 and we're feeling nostalgic so we're sticking to our roots. Its psychedelic folk, funky Arabic bits, some weird electronics, and some artists your Dad loves. The solstice is upon us and the days are much too short, Sophie and Emily will still be trudging around in the wet and cold and you should too. The top tips for days out from Edinburgh are the Ormiston Yew, Huly Hill Cairn, Ravenswood Avenue Standing Stone, Temple in Midlothian, and Cairnpapple Hill near Bathgate. Is it time for the BFGB (Bog Factor Guide Book)??
